verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own docs describe previewing HTML and document files, with the preview reloading automatically when the file or any local asset it depends on changes. They also document a JavaScript console and External URL previewing from other devices, so HTML preview with live reload is clearly covered. Markdown rendering is never named explicitly (only the generic "document files"), which leaves part of the story unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Markdown rendering, clarity on which "other" rendered file types are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the live-reload preview.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview Markdown, HTML, and other rendered files with live reload
